name: agent-index-filesystem-onedrive
description: Filesystem adapter for Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint document libraries. v2.2.1 (Release B.2 — identityperm): resolveIdentity now requests the delegated Microsoft Graph 'User.Read.All' scope it actually needs — plain 'User.Read' only reads the signed-in user's OWN profile, so GET /users/{other} and the proxyAddresses $filter 403'd and the resolver could never see another member (the B.1 identitymap resolver was non-functional against a live tenant; unit-test mocks hid the gap). A 403/Authorization_RequestDenied is now surfaced as a distinct ACCESS_DENIED carrying an 'add User.Read.All + grant admin consent + re-authenticate' message instead of being masked as INVALID_SUBJECT 'no matching user' (errormask). aifs_resolve_identity also accepts common arg aliases (email/subject/identity/upn/user/member/recipient), not just 'ref'. NOTE: existing installs must add User.Read.All to the Entra app, grant admin consent, and re-authenticate to pick up the broadened scope. v2.2.0 (Release B.1): adds aifs_resolve_identity (Graph lookup mapping a member's email/UPN/proxy to the grantable tenant identity — the identitymap fix; gdrive analog is a passthrough); hardens PKCE verifier persistence to a sandbox-local path so it survives between exec processes (pkcerestart root cause — the workspace-mount write was lost to a write-then-read race), with verifier reuse on re-issued start; aifs_authenticate infers complete when an auth_code is present; recipient-not-resolvable Graph errors (incl. the generic 'sharingFailed') are now classified as INVALID_SUBJECT instead of looking transient. v2.1.0 (Release B — multi-member ACL): full contract-2.0 parity with gdrive — implements share/unshare/getPermissions/search on Microsoft Graph, transferOwnership returns a clear NOT_IMPLEMENTED (OneDrive/SharePoint have no per-item ownership transfer; member departure is handled via owner_departed + M365 admin retention). Sharing is ADDITIVE ONLY — inheritance is never broken (inherit:false is deprecated and ignored per decision 2026-06-15-deprecate-inherit-false); the limited-visibility pattern is structural inheritance + member-space owned content, identical on both backends. Privileged ops route only through the permission-change-helper (user-Accept, member token); getPermissions is read-only/agent-callable. v2.0.3 (reliability 2): rebuilt on framework 2.2.1 — proxy diagnostics now go to stderr so byte-exact aifs_read isn't polluted in proxied sandboxes. v2.0.2 (reliability): fetch now routes through HTTPS_PROXY with the MITM CA trusted (framework 2.2.0 sets an undici proxy dispatcher — fixes 'fetch failed' in every proxied Cowork sandbox); aifs_write verifies stored byte-size on every write (not just sentinel files); required_domains now includes the tenant SharePoint content hosts. v2.0.0 (P1 core-ops): contract-2.0 core-ops parity with gdrive — read/write/list/exists/stat/delete/copy, single-tenant public-client PKCE auth (no secret), id-anchored member-space addressing, byte-exact reads, AIFS:FILE-END sentinel write-verification, async copy, and large-file upload sessions. Revision-aware writes use Graph cTag compare + If-Match eTag backstop (write_supports_if_revision flips true once the live 412 probe passes). ACL ops (share/unshare/getPermissions/search/transferOwnership) are the fast-follow.
author: agent-index

tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) directory (tenant) ID for the org's Microsoft 365 tenant. Single-tenant app.

client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the org's Entra app registration. Public client — no secret. Requires 'Allow public client flows = Yes' on the app's Authentication settings.

site_id.description: SharePoint site ID hosting the org-remote document library (the org-remote root). Required for SharePoint document libraries; omit for personal OneDrive.

drive_id.description: OneDrive or SharePoint document-library drive ID used as the filesystem root. Omit for the site's / user's default drive.

all_members_group.description: The tenant Microsoft 365 group that represents 'all org members' — its email (e.g. agentindex-members@contoso.onmicrosoft.com) or objectId (GUID). 'Share with org' grants this group reader; collaborator folders grant it writer. create-org captures or derives it from the SharePoint site's membership. Used additively only (no inheritance breaking).

required_domains_note: Content reads and >4MB uploads 302-redirect from graph.microsoft.com to the tenant content host {tenant}.sharepoint.com (and {tenant}-my.sharepoint.com for member OneDrive). These are per-tenant, so they appear here as patterns; create-org resolves and reachability-tests the concrete hosts after authentication (post-auth gate).
